answer_key.what: as launch P1b used it (builder of master fa639b61): birth date 1 July of the visit's year minus the age; placed age lines in years, written even when the protocol states the bound; JMED truth from the structured 主病名/既往歴/現病歴

pregnancy.answer_by: person at the visit; codes for a recorded pregnancy
pregnancy.label: pregnancy and contraception

ladder.what: patient-criterion cells by the rung that decided them; decided = verdict pass or fail

label_conflicts.what: pairs labelled eligible whose own criterion labels exclude the patient (inclusion not included, or exclusion excluded): a conflict inside the gold, with the box's answer

denominators.eligible_lost: gold-eligible pairs the box answered (protocol screened and the patient in its SCREEN): the figure on the key as published
denominators.eligible_lost_without_conflicted: the same, without the pairs the key marks conflicted (D-1064): the figure the target reads, on a key that marks them
denominators.unanswered: every gold-eligible and gold-excluded pair (pairs_in_gold); unanswered_by_protocol splits it by the status of the pair's protocol
denominators.wrong_exclusions: the box's exclusions of gold-eligible or gold-excluded pairs

attempts.line: attempts: 1; protocols finished in attempt 1: 1; still cut: 0

statuses.not_in_answers: not in answers.json (not run: filtered out, or the set stopped first)
statuses.not_run_time_budget: not run: cut by the set's time budget (not a failure)
statuses.unfinished: in answers.json with no end the scorer knows

protocols.target: fewer than one protocol in ten of those attempted fails (before or in SCREEN; the target reads this wider share, and the share failed before SCREEN is printed beside it); attempted = screened + compiled + failed + unfinished (budget cuts and protocols not in answers.json are not)
protocols.what: each protocol of the set by what became of it; a failure is counted by class and stays in the denominator; a budget cut is not a failure and not attempted

what: joined by ids after the run; the gold was not in the box
